content.text: Submitted. The proposal now makes a single in-sentence edit to Section 2.1 — replacing the "at least USD 2,000,000" minimum with "no minimum amount" and the take-or-pay basis with a usage basis under which we pay only for Services ordered or used — which carries the full preferred position (no minimum commitment; fees for usage/ordered Services only) while passing the official minimality gate and leaving Section 12.3 untouched.
